text:
Emily: I opened a docs PR to update Helion-13B and VesperX-4B model cards: clarify sequence limits per-deployment, fix embedding unit labels, and add a small migration note for SDK field name changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834.

Raj: Quick skim 1: Helion card shows `max_total_tokens: 16384` but our hosted tier only supports 8192. We should add a clear per-deployment table.

Mike: Bench note: I re-ran VesperX-4B on g5.12x with seq=1024 batch=16. Median tokens/s=3,820; 95p=3,200. Old doc number came from p4d run. I'll upload CSV to the PR.

docsbot: PR #834 created by emily  checks started (docs-lint, bench-ci, link-check).

Sam: SDK snippet: I'll add Python + TS examples using `max_output_tokens` and a small streaming example. Also include a fallback example that chooses `vesperx-lite` if latency_policy triggers. Short snippet: ```python
from redwood import Client
cli=Client()
for chunk in cli.generate(model="vesperx-4b", prompt="Hello").stream():
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

Emily: I added a "Deployment limits" table and noted Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private. Also fixed embedding units to "embeddings/sec" per guidelines. PTAL.

Raj: One compat nit: Helion int8 profile needs runtime >=2.5.0, otherwise recommend variant `helion-13b-no-quant`. Suggest exact sentence: "On runtime < 2.5.0, use the `helion-13b-no-quant` variant or upgrade the runtime to avoid compilation failures."

Mike: CSV uploaded and bench-ci passed. I updated the VesperX numbers and left p4d numbers in a dedicated subsection.

Emily: Great. Any objections to merging tonight so infra can pick up the compat table for routing changes?

Sam: LGTM :thumbsup:

Raj: LGTM, added a short routing fallback note to aurora-lite3b for capacity degradation.

Emily: Merging now. I'll post a short note to #release-war-room and ping infra. Thanks all!
